description: This file contains functions for rendering a 3D plane's edges and faces using OpenGL. It defines functions to draw the outline (edges) and filled surface (faces) of a plane with specified dimensions and color.

methods.name: void lu5_render_plane_edges(lua_Number half_x,lua_Number half_y,lu5_color color)
methods.description: Renders the edges of a 3D plane with specified half-widths and color.

methods.name: void lu5_render_plane_faces(lua_Number half_x,lua_Number half_y,lu5_color color)
methods.description: Renders the filled faces of a 3D plane with specified half-widths and color.
